intro.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that removes duplicate numbers from a sorted array, returning the new length of the modified array. You will learn the core concept of using a two-pointer technique to efficiently traverse and modify the array in-place. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, loops, and conditional logic. This exercise will help you practice manipulating data structures while keeping your code clean and performant.
intro.usecase: This algorithm is essential for cleaning and optimizing data displays in real applications. You'll use it when building dashboard components that show unique user metrics from sorted logs, or in e-commerce filters that need to display distinct product categories without duplicates. It's also crucial for data processing pipelines that prepare sorted datasets for visualization charts or reports, ensuring each data point appears only once while maintaining order.
